title: queueHold changes that leave the queue projection hash unchanged (retry reschedule, exhaustion) may not reach the UI promptly
outcome: A change of a session's automatic-retry queueHold (its cause, its next retryAt, or the hold clearing while the latch stays set) reaches the UI promptly, as the hold itself does.
acceptance: Either every change of engram_automatic_retry_hold(record) for a session publishes a delta or summary that carries the new queueHold, or the hold is folded into the queue projection hash so the queue delta path carries it. A test drives a retry reschedule (same latch and prompts, a new retryAt) and an exhaustion (the latch kept, the hold cleared), and shows the UI-facing projection updated.
